issues.jp_before: 時間[じかん]が{あれば/あったら|cd-regret}、もっとゆっくり話[はな]せるのに。
issues.problem: English 'talk with you more slowly' mistranslates ゆっくり話す (talk at leisure).
issues.action: English changed to 'If I had time, we could have a longer, more relaxed talk.'

issues.jp_before: 聞[き]きたいことがあるなら、{聞[き]けばよかったのに/聞[き]いたらよかったのに|cd-regret}。
issues.problem: Tense clash: present あるなら with a past reproach; the English already says 'had'.
issues.action: Changed あるなら to あったなら.

issues.jp_before: 宝[たから]くじが{当[あ]たったら/当[あ]たれば|cd-regret}いいのに。
issues.problem: Unnatural English 'I wish I would win the lottery'.
issues.action: English changed to 'If only I could win the lottery.'

issues.jp_before: たとえ{高[たか]くなくても|cd-temo}、おいしい店[みせ]はたくさんあります。
issues.problem: たとえ (hypothetical) is unnatural with a general statement about restaurants, and the sentence lacked a subject for 高くない.
issues.action: Rewrote as 値段[ねだん]が{高[たか]くなくても|cd-temo}、おいしい店[みせ]はたくさんあります。 with matching English.

issues.jp_before: たとえお金[かね]が{なくても|cd-temo}、彼[かれ]はいつも楽[たの]しそうです。
issues.problem: たとえ is odd with a habitual factual statement (いつも).
issues.action: Dropped たとえ; English 'Even when he has no money...'.

issues.jp_before: 毎日[まいにち]{練習[れんしゅう]しても|cd-temo}、なかなか上手[じょうず]になりません。
issues.problem: English 'Even if I practise... I don't get good easily' is unnatural for a factual concession.
issues.action: English changed to 'Even though I practise every day, I'm not getting much better.'

issues.jp_before: たとえ年[とし]を{とっても|cd-temo}、新[あたら]しいことに挑戦[ちょうせん]したい。
issues.problem: たとえ is unnatural with an inevitable event like ageing.
issues.action: Dropped たとえ and rewrote 'why' accordingly.
